tests.scope: Two production renderers, independent caches versus a shared synchronous 512x32 cache. Six full 720p frames and old-new-old transitions, 50MHz memory/75MHz video, randomized grant waits, mixed four/sixty-four-word response bursts, pause/touch, same-cycle final RGB/menu/errors/frame indexes and identical memory requests.

details.scope: Exhaustive channel arithmetic plus CPU material oracle at four light directions over all 24 views, not a board capture or physical luminance measurement.

tests.scope: Original control conditions compared exhaustively with the actual production register block, delayed one clock; complete top wiring checked against pinned thumbnail upstream, including intended preview geometry changes.
Actual production top and result FSM; hardware shells omit unrelated blocks. Same qualified event trace shifted one clock; raw busy feedback window settles one clock later.

Production A/B frame_store RTL with original-width controller port shells. Checks length selection, two-stage mode CDC and slot bounds; not SDRAM electrical simulation. Full link and real frame-FIFO pressure are separate tests.
Production row decoder and arbiter versus pinned independent uncompressed donor, all 120 fields and 68 rows, both current/following cache banks, wrap, refresh/contention.
Actual final Blender meshes checked independently with local solid ray parity; all camera angles share rigid object transforms. Material silhouette and firmware pixel output are tested separately.

Only timeout comparison implementation changes. Counter wraps at 32 bits, timer_reset exposes zero immediately and loads count=1 on the next edge. All packet/control logic outside this timer block is unchanged. Actual old/new timer code compared around each threshold, wrap and randomized clears in nine parameter configurations.
Real production UART TX/RX; local state/timer positioning only for deterministic reconnect/CRC collision.
Production photo_award_render plus photo_award_memory; players/video effect are interface stubs. Logical CDC/owner routing proof, not analog metastability simulation.
Real production controller planner; scheduler held at WAIT_CONTEXT and accepted cache metadata positioned deterministically. UART/transport tested separately.

512-phase exhaustive function comparison; same-cycle complete 1280x720 award_fx output differential against frozen original production source renamed only; shared real sprite ROM; five-clock bypass identity checked.
